notes.title: 1.9.2 hits Steam!
notes.notes:
Hi, long time no see!

We've working hard to get you a new update for PD! This update has been delayed more than we expected due to unforeseen problems with Windows 10 and Mac OSX El Capitan, so if you have problems with those system versions (well, or any other :D) after this update, please give us a shout in the forums (marking it with [BUG] so we don't overlook it)

Onwards with the changelog!
[list]
[*] Improved Catalogus
[*] Improved tiles
[*] New Berserker's perk
[*] Any wand can be merged with another wand of the same type
[*] Wand Of Flock spawns fewer sheep, but they block line of sight and live longer 
[*] Wand of Avalanche is buffed
[*] Wand of Firebolt is slightly nerfed
[*] Sacrificial mark gets propagated on attack
[*] All mobs on a level get beckoned when someone steps into sacrificial fire
[*] More "scroll-like" behaviour of Scroll of Wipe Out
[*] Shift+clicking a tile makes a character go to that tile without performing any other actions
[*] Some typos fixed
[*] and more...
[/list]
In any case, Merry Christmas to you all, and thanks for supporting us!

notes.title: 1.9.1 released!
notes.notes:
Just so you know, we’ve not been sitting on our hands for the past few weeks! We’ve cooked an awesome release that we hope you’ll enjoy :). Here is a list of changes, in case you’re wondering:
[list]
[*]Added: Tome of Remastery
[*]Added: New Sad Ghost's quest
[*]Added: New Old Wandmaker's quest
[*]Added: Auto-targetting for missile weapons and wands
[*]Added: Sacrificial chamber
[*]Changed: Wand of Telekinesis is replaced with Wand of Reach
[*]Changed: Degradation system
[*]Changed: Durability of all items increased
[*]Changed: Burnt tiles may be flooded
[*]Changed: Some vfx
[*]Changed: Some in-game texts
[*]Changed: Wand of Avalanche "presses" affected tiles
[*]Fixed: Incorrect dungeon layer name on the start screen
[*]Fixed: Crash when Scroll of Challenge affects the Shopkeeper
[*]Fixed: Final score formula
[*]Fixed: Typos
[/list]

notes.title: 1.9.1 is coming to Steam and iOS on Sept. 4th!
notes.notes:
The next Pixel Dungeon update for Steam and iOS with a lot of new features and improvements (no new levels/classes though :P) will be released on September 4th. You may wonder why we announce it so much in advance? The reason is this time we are going to try to [b]release for several platforms at the same time[/b] and it requires some serious planning. And since we have plans, why not to share them? ːsteamhappyː

For the first time in the (not so long) history of Pixel Dungeon the version for all supported platforms will become equal in a sense of game mechanics! To commemorate this event [b]we are starting a 2-weeks long promotional sale on Steam[/b] right till the date of the release. Don't miss it! ːsteamhappyː

notes.title: First Pixel Dungeon update!
notes.notes:
Hi there!

We've been in radio silence mode for the past month or so, but we've been working hard on improving the game! Besides patching those pesky bugs, we've tried to add some new things as well, the most useful of all is partial controller support (and better mouse support as well)! With partial we mean that you can bind mouse/controller buttons (and only buttons) to actions in the game. So you can't yet navigate through menus or select a particular cell using only your controller, but we are working on full controller support.

Here is the full list of improvements:
[list]
[*] Slower character movement when navigated using a keyboard
[*] Shortcuts for throwing items, drinking potions, reading scrolls, zapping wands and planting seeds
[*] No auto-descend/ascend when navigating a hero using keyboard
[*] No "running into a wall"
[*] Mouse and game controller buttons as bindable keys
[*] "Scrollbars"
[*] "Miraculous revival" bug fixed
[/list]

If you see one of your issues listed here, please check that everything works as intended. If you continue to see any bugs, please report them on the discussion forum on Steam!

As always, please share your feedback, we are listening even if we don't have the time to reply to every post!

notes.title: Wot I Think: Pixel Dungeon
notes.notes:
Oh happy day! There is no roguelite I’ve played more of, nor enjoyed more, than Pixel Dungeon. But until now its modern versions being confined to my portable telephone has precluded declaring said delight in the hallowed halls of PC gaming.
